original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.
Only changing helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, entrances and cleanup contract already covered by #1995/#2013.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: On our PR2942 words (PR2917 plus four normal-45 paired extractions): a joint codimension-2 end-frame lowering of 22 restored helpers to five shared rank-7 subspaces (frame-only), the five further rank-8 paired extractions it makes profitable (normal 42: 226, 228, 230; normal 7: 363, 395; 91 private buffers, a sixth width class), Jeremy Kothe's fourteen PR2957 rewrites composed exactly, a literal T74 allocation of the changed inventory, and complete fresh-native admission and modern outer release against Dugongue's PR2969 headline.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed helper inventory beats current packing. The fill layer of the PR2942/PR2957 words is exhausted (PR2969 attains their cap), so a gain must change the words. Stage 1 alone is of the class the card's trigger names (helper terminal subspaces and monotone frames within the fixed scalar word, bounded by #1995/#2013 on the selected k8 word); here it is applied to restored paired-extraction helpers of a different word and is composed with a changed scalar word (five new paired extractions, which the lowering makes profitable, and PR2957's rewrites), so the entrance/cleanup contract and the inventory change (91 buffers, width-6 helpers). Finite exact identities and a fully charged literal allocation are required, as for PR2917/PR2942.
bottleneck_link: 22 restored helpers lose one end dimension (four 8 -> 7, two 8 -> 7 from PR2917, sixteen entering helpers 7 -> 6), five helpers change width 9 to 8 and five private buffers are added; the local profile changes by 11H1 + 74H2 - 54H3 + 4H4 - 8H5 per call. The fixed-capacity cap rises from PR2942's 0.0017228173 to 0.0017290358 (PR2969 attains 0.0017240352 for PR2942 + PR2957); the literal allocation realizes all but the recorded gap of it.
stop_rule: Freeze the three-stage composition after exact local checks; publish a higher conditional kappa only if both native providers, literal owner geometry, physical stock, prefix and complete outer admission pass strictly above the PR2969 headline.
evidence: Search (construction/STAGE-PRICES.json): every single rank-7 end-frame lowering of a restored helper is below break-even; joint lowering per shared subspace pays (+22,972 / +42,541 / +42,541 / +17,170 / +17,170 units); the lowered partners make normals 42 and 7 profitable (+36,145, +30,758); fresh 9 -> 7 extractions at all 43,435 rank-7 subspaces are an exact negative on PR2942 (a 7-dim subspace lies in exactly three hyperplanes, which must all pair). Checks: run_registered.py (stdlib): package pins; verify.py (producer reconstruction of every stage word, stage-1 validity, five structure certificates per provider, PR2833 auditor forward/dual on every stage word, frame accounting, 86 semantic controls, price evidence, overlay spec round trip); check_allocation.py (owner engine, five controls, physical 66,813, exact moment vs PR2969); check_cap.py (Fractions-only caps of the parent and every stage, recorded literal gap, exact gains over PR2969/PR2966/PR2957/PR2942); stored receipts binding. reproduce.py: exact Git exports of PR2908/PR2917/PR2942/PR2957/PR2966/PR2969 (and through them PR2894/PR2833), fresh retained bootstrap, PR2917 derived source plus the rank7-joint-endframes stage, 91-buffer adapters, fresh native chains for both providers and complete admission: PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE and PASS_RELEASE at the claimed kappa.
